{{Quote|Princess Leia was correct in recognizing this as the emblem of the Republic, but this one&hellip; this one once adorned the podium of the Senate Rotunda. [[File:SenateCrest-TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|The Insignia of Unity (pictured on the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]]) was made out of several materials including orichalum.]]
